name: spideli-functions
description: Server-side push for the Spideli apps: the sendPush HTTPS function replaces the service-account key the apps used to download.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="$PWD/e2e/offline-credentials.json" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-spideli "node --test e2e/"
scripts.serve: npm run build && GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="$PWD/e2e/offline-credentials.json" firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-spideli
